scope.summary: Implement real frontend lifecycle actions for Evolution matching backend contracts from EVO-PROGRAM-ACTIONS-CLOSURE-CORRECTIVE-001 (D1, D2, D3). Evolution program state (draft, under_review, active, paused, stopped, completed, retired) is distinct from run state. Pause, stop, and freeze are strictly distinct actions: pause_program drains and can resume; stop stops program and cancels nonterminal runs without resume; freeze_generation freezes generation and blocks promotions and mutation approvals until unfreeze. Resume button wired to resumeEvolutionProgram. Constraints durably read from program.constraints. Fixed-empty lists replaced with real backend program data. Synthetic IDs removed. Promotion action names aligned with backend (promote_candidate_paper, promote_candidate_live) with required candidate_id. Capital authority remains none with zero live trading side effects.

ppl_alloc_007_provenance_hold.note: Verified PPL-ALLOC-007 has no active worker or lease and its provenance hold is respected.

lifecycle_actions.description: Submit draft evolution program for review.
Pause program execution; runs drain gracefully; can be resumed.
Resume paused program; backend strictly refuses resume from stopped state with 409.
Stop program permanently; cancels nonterminal runs; requires high-risk confirmation token; cannot be resumed.
Retire completed or stopped evolution program.
Sets is_frozen=true; blocks candidate promotions and mutation approvals.
Sets is_frozen=false; unblocks promotions and mutation approvals.
Promotes candidate with candidate_id parameter; blocked when generation is frozen.
